svg.title: The road to driverless operation
svg.desc: The robotaxi on a road with seven gate posts, G0 to G6, standing at the project's current position: Before G0: hazard analysis draft. Under each gate, its exit criterion from WP-M-00 §2 and how many of the work products it needs are approved and drafted. G0 Governance: 0 of 20 approved, 2 drafted. G1 Concept: 0 of 15 approved, 12 drafted. G2 System design: 0 of 17 approved, 7 drafted. G3 HW/SW development: 0 of 21 approved, 0 drafted. G4 Integration and verification: 0 of 9 approved, 3 drafted. G5 Validation and release: 0 of 15 approved, 0 drafted. G6 Operation: 0 of 3 approved, 0 drafted.

g.text: The gates of WP-M-00 §2. A gate passes only when every work product it needs is approved. Now: Before G0: hazard analysis draft.
